long_biography.plain_text:
Hamad Jassim Al Darwish Fakhroo studied at United Arab Emirates University before building a career in investment management. In 2006 he co-founded Al Hail Holding in Abu Dhabi and developed it into a diversified investment company spanning finance, real estate, energy, healthcare, education and infrastructure. The group expanded through direct investments, funds and strategic partnerships.

As chief executive, Al Darwish combines ownership with active corporate governance. Al Hail took a majority interest in a UAE leasing business, and he later joined the board of digital bank Zand. He also co-founded Medad Holding in 2018, directing capital toward biotechnology, healthcare, digital transformation and strategic real assets. His wider appointments include chairmanships in currency exchange and finance leasing and board representation in business services.

uncertainties.detail: The authoritative owner input records Al Darwish as Hasba's current owner from May 2025 and gives vessel ID 25186, 38.4 metres and 286 gross tonnes. SuperYacht Times and YachtCharterFleet independently confirm the exact vessel and dimensions, but public yacht pages do not disclose the owner's name; SuperYacht Times keeps that field in its subscription product.

Corporate and regulatory records use Hamad Jassim Al Darwish Fakhroo, while current Al Hail, Medad, Zand and LinkedIn profiles usually omit Fakhroo. Transguard's audited report supplies the decisive bridge by naming Hamad Jassim Al Darwish Fakhroo as Al Hail Holding's representative.

The upstream record stores Hamad Jassim as the first-name field and Al Darwish Fakhroo as the surname. Public material does not consistently distinguish patronymic and family-name components, so the dossier preserves the full display name and does not propose moving Jassim into the blank middle-names field.

UK Companies House establishes October 1967 for the exact full-name Emirati director. It does not publish a day or birthplace, and nationality and residence do not prove birth country, so only the month and year are proposed.

Current biographies describe Al Darwish as a co-founder and serial entrepreneur, and regulatory statements establish a personally controlled investment vehicle. They do not document his starting capital, family transfers, net worth or consolidated ownership across Al Hail and Medad, so Self-made is used without a more specific independence or advantage label.

Al Hail and Medad currently identify Al Darwish as an executive leader. The DFSA role ended in 2020, the Transguard evidence is from its 2020 annual report and the Zand board announcement dates to 2022; those roles are treated as historic or dated evidence unless a current source independently renews them.

The upstream LinkedIn URL matches the exact investment executive through UAE, education, Al Hail and Zand anchors. No separate Instagram, personal website, Facebook, X or Wikipedia profile met the proposal threshold, while company pages remain sources rather than personal social proposals.

Asset management captures the long-term founder-control of diversified investment platforms. Banking, Venture capital, Commercial real estate and Private equity were considered but not separately assigned because the evidence shows portfolio exposure or narrower operating mandates that would add redundant or over-specific click-through groupings.

Review Finance & Investments / Finance & Investments / Self-made / Founder. Hamad Jassim Al Darwish Fakhroo resolves through the authoritative Hasba record, exact-full-name corporate and regulatory filings, and Transguard's direct bridge from that legal-style name to Al Hail Holding. His causal wealth platform is the founding and executive control of diversified investment firms, supported by documented acquisitions, a personally controlled investment vehicle and current company leadership. The dossier proposes a known-for title, October 1967, Alive status and a vessel-independent biography. It does not infer a birthplace, family inheritance, net worth, consolidated stake, name-field rearrangement or unsupported social account. Nothing has been compiled, approved or applied.
